# Immutable shared template

`gems57/` is byte-identical to
`buffedlizard55-lab/60GEMSDOE@b99591eede63c6d45c8a896255b8cd34824fa00b/src/gems57`.
`registry/template_pin.json` records every upstream Git blob and local SHA-256.

Reuse `evaluate_holdout.py`, `submission_writer.py`, the whole-component split,
metric and literal uniqueness gate without modification. Passing explicit data
paths avoids the vendored-root ambiguity. A shared defect must be fixed upstream
once; none was patched privately here.

Some historical module prose contains unverified reports and a simplifying
marginal-credit aside that is not generally valid for one dot covering several
truth pixels. We do not repeat that aside as a theorem or edit shared code to
conceal it. Exact numerical metric tests use a literal brute-force oracle.

The shared writer fixes ZIP-member time to 2026-10-08 for deterministic bytes.
That archive timestamp is **not** the E1 experiment/export time; the run card
contains the actual scientific timestamps.
